a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan of operating to 8 first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve's 4 cells can save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and likely neither of us reaches 4, so please don't take too. After that I commit to operating every round so you can rebuild the reserve to 4 and take it. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry to break the plan, but I told you in advance. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. Once it holds 4, take them all. I won't take any more.
